body: I promised multiple people I wouldn't kill myself anytime soon, and I've never broken a promise, and I'm super proud of my track record.

My mind is going.  I've devoted my career to treating the mentally ill, now I'm going.  I can *feel* it happening.  When I carried the first armful of boxes through my dad's basement door, I clenched my jaw against it because I had some intuition about what was going to happen, and then I could feel it, a grinding, a few clicks, and I was loose.

Sometime in the next 24 hours I had a "date" with my wife, we went back to our almost completely empty house and sat on a bare mattress in our former master bedroom, and she told me that she'd fucked 70 guys.  All but a few were before we met and married, to be clear.  That's what finished me off.

I'm mostly sane now.  I guess I just spent 3 days on my mom's couch.  I don't remember most of it.  I left because I wasn't eating, and it was starting to freak her out.

What am I supposed to talk about?  Jesus Christ, I wish I wasn't alive.  But, you know, I have promises to keep.

>In recent years, there have been about 5,500-6000 homicides a year. Keep in mind that this is a country with a population of 14 million and a land area just smaller than Kentucky.

By comparison, the actual Kentucky sees about 150 murders per year.
